sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: Quanta Computer and LG Electronics dispute whether selling patented components exhausts patent rights. Quanta argues that an authorized sale removes items from patent protection. LG argues that the sale did not exhaust the system and method patents. The Court must decide which interpretation applies.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: This case defines the scope of patent exhaustion. It determines when patent rights end after a sale. It affects how companies structure component sales. It shapes the balance between patent holders and buyers.
